LAB Plus 1.0.3

- Added a small application version label beside the title, using EternalUi2Regular.
- Added an optional startup check for newer stable GitHub releases, with a compact dialog matching the application style.
- Choose Yes, No, or Don't ask again for this version. Older versions remain usable, and offline starts show no update prompt.
- Updates install into the same folder, preserve settings, checkpoints and logs, and restart LAB Plus automatically.
- Added download validation and recovery of previous files if installation fails.

Extract the entire Windows x64 archive and run LABPlus.exe. Keep all included files together. Requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime x64 and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
